If you're reading this, then you're wondering why this subverse is here. In short, it exists because I recently discovered that ASMR in which the lead artist displays a dominant presence is the most reliable trigger I've ever experienced. Where other triggers temporarily seem to lessen in effect with prolonged exposure, there are certain videos by various ASMR artists that trigger me no matter how often I listened to them.

Anyways, after doing a bit of research, all I could find about the subject was a singular post over at the Reddit ASMR community. With my curiosity baited, the idea to set up this marvelous pot of honey was forged. Partly to see if others enjoy ASMR the same way, and partly as my own personal repository.

Now, I know some folk in the ASMR community find discussing the issue a little "taboo". Perhaps this is because the words "assertive" and "dominant" have come to be associated with sexuality more than personality or demeanour. Understand that if how others experience or enjoy their ASMR is something that really bothers you, then you will probably be better served by other subverses about ASMR. That being said, everyone is welcome here.

Enjoy.

PS: Oh- and please don't read too much into the gender of the artists that post. I post what triggers me. You should post what- and who- triggers you.
